content: Secret Santa / gift-exchange privacy: there is no way for a pure client-only app to hide the pairing from someone who can read the database directly, because the admin's own browser runs the same SDK credentials and can issue arbitrary queries. Standard practical mitigations for a friends-only app are (1) store the recipient only on the giver's own document so no single document contains the full mapping, (2) hardcode the draw in-app / never persist the mapping, or (3) accept that the admin is trusted and design the UI + export so the pairing is never surfaced by accident. Full cryptographic secrecy requires a trusted server or per-participant encryption.
